title: Frag-Tank PAR and Light-Schedule Consistency
dataSources: Reef-tank parameters (`reeftank:param`), auto-top-off events (`ato:event`), dosing and feeding events (`doser:event`, `reeftank:feeding`), planted-tank CO2 (`plantedtank:co2`), quarantine observations (`quarantine:observation`), frag lighting (`fraglight:reading`), and leak telemetry (`leaksensor:event`).
app: Aquarium and vivarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, GHL, ESPHome, leak sensors, dosing systems, planted-tank controllers, quarantine logs, and PAR meters streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and controller APIs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fraglight:reading
| stats avg(par_umol) as avg_par_umol stdev(par_umol) as par_stdev_umol by zone
| sort - avg_par_umol
description: Measures average PAR and variability by frag zone so inconsistent lighting is easy to diagnose.
value: Coral growth often reflects light consistency more than a single target number, making PAR stability worth tracking directly.
implementation: Capture periodic PAR samples and zone identifiers from your frag rack or light-mapping sessions.
visualization: Bar chart of average PAR and variability by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether parts of the frag tank are getting steady light or swinging around too much.
